title: MFEM：Gauss 積分精確度與有限元素混疊
titleEn: MFEM: Gauss quadrature exactness and finite-element aliasing
subcategoryTitle: 地球、流體與離散物理驗證
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「MFEM：Gauss 積分精確度與有限元素混疊」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付節點權重表、解析與離散積分、混疊反例及幾何映射檢查。
summaryEn: Investigate MFEM: Gauss quadrature exactness and finite-element aliasing using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver node-weight tables, analytic and discrete integrals, an aliasing counterexample and a geometry-mapping checklist tied to the actual finite-element integrand.

scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.descriptionEn: Integrate x to the fourth analytically and evaluate both endpoints. Cross-check using even symmetry and twice the half-interval integral, retaining the exact rational value two fifths before decimal conversion.
